olivia: Hi everyone -- just joined today, excited to be here! Quick Q: who owns escalation for model serving vs infra? Also who approves onboarding access to the dev GPU pool and PagerDuty?

zara: welcome!! :tada: short answers: eng-platform owns model-serving configs and rollout policy. eng-runtime owns the inference runtime (model process). eng-sre owns cluster/node/network infra and PagerDuty rota for infra alerts.

ben: Adding process: if the model is acting up (runtime errors, runaway mem), page eng-runtime. If the cluster nodes are flapping or disk/network issues, page eng-sre. For rollout problems (bad weights/config), loop in eng-platform.

olivia: thanks — who approves access to the "dev-gpu" project? and is there a short checklist for new-hires to get on-call-ready?

marta: access flow: manager approves IAM request, people-ops triages, infra team grants project role. Fill this form: https://redwood.internal/access-request and select "dev-gpu" + "pagerduty-new-hire". For temporary sudo on nodes request the "gpu-admin" role and include a justification.

sam: FYI for PagerDuty: we only add folks to rotations after a short shadowing period (1-2 weeks) and a manager sign-off. Please ask your manager to DM me once you complete the runbook walk-through.

olivia: where are the runbooks and the quick escalation matrix?

oncall-bot: Runbook index: https://redwood.internal/runbooks. Recommended: /runbooks/inference/first-responders and /runbooks/platform/rollouts.

zara: here's a tiny cheat-sheet I paste into PR comments often:
```
Escalation cheat-sheet
1) Detect: post in #incidents + tag team on-call (eng-runtime or eng-sre)
2) 0-5m: on-call ack and triage (if none, escalate)
3) 5-15m: page secondary (platform lead @marta) and add incident channel
4) 15m+: call incident commander, exec on-call, and consider rollback
Security issues: page eng-security immediately and do NOT share logs publicly.
```

ben: small note: for canary rollbacks, prefix message with "rollback" so the rollout bot auto-triggers the rollback checklist. If you're unsure, ping eng-platform on-call and say "shadowing new hire" and someone will guide you.

marta: also, if you need to escalate across teams (e.g., runtime + infra), page both and tag me — I own cross-team coordination for serving incidents.

olivia: perfect. I'll submit the form and ping my manager to get the sign-off. Thanks y'all! :raised_hands:

zara: welcome again, and feel free to DM me if you want a quick runbook walkthrough today.

oncall-bot: Note: eng-sre rota changes 2026-07-01; check on-call calendar: https://redwood.internal/oncall-calendar

olivia: will do — appreciate the quick responses.
